Keep the official gold H/R monogram recognizable, using the same delicate interwoven H and looping calligraphic R mark already present in the reference. NO readable words, digits, slogans, WEDDING captions or invented tiny text; only the official small H/R monogram. Truly transparent alpha outside the existing object group. Very crisp full-resolution final.

assets.prompt:
